Elected stewards responsible for the temporal affairs of the parish, serving alongside the presiding priest.

Who leads it

The Council roster is published in one place only — on the About page — so that a correction has one page to reach. The committees each member leads are on the Parish Council Committees page.

How to get involved

The Parish Council is elected by the stewards of the parish, so unlike the other ministries here it is not one you join by volunteering. How a steward stands for election, and when elections are held, is among what this page is still waiting on. Council members are parishioners rather than staff, and are glad to be asked questions in the meantime.
